Voltgrid investor presentation 2026

Voltgrid Corp is a manufacturer of liquid-filled power transformers serving regional utilities and industrial customers. This presentation summarises the company's operations, order backlog and capacity plans.

Management states that it is targeting a line extension at its second plant and that it expects utility framework orders to remain the main source of demand.

The company describes itself as a leading supplier of transformers below 345 kV in its home market.
